The polyfill Bloom filter and traversal hot-loop edits are algorithmic.
notes: No body; from subject and added functions (inferred:).

subject: jutil: index LinkedHashMap with a pointer-free open-addressing table
areas: jutil collections.go LinkedHashMap / LinkedHashSet, ImmutableMap builder
what: Replaces the map[K]int index of large LinkedHashMaps by a linear-probing table of uint32 slot numbers (noscan, tombstones) hashed with maphash.Comparable; slot value placed first so sets are not padded.
measured_effect: typed-full peak live 556 -> 522 MB, RSS 923 -> 845 MB, alloc 1.39 -> 1.29 GB; bundle peak live 239 -> 213 MB, RSS 495 -> 424 MB
mech_form: LinkedHashMap/LinkedHashSet in the runtime as a slot slice plus a pointer-free open-addressing uint32 index (5-16 B per entry) instead of a Go map index.
notes: Notes a Go 1.24 maphash.Comparable compiler bug workaround for interface keys.

subject: jscomp: replace pooled scopeArena with plain Scope allocation
areas: jscomp scope.go (-1358 lines), SyntacticScopeCreator, FunctionToBlockMutator, NodeTraversal, ReferenceCollector
what: Deletes the pooled scopeArena (four atomic slots plus sync.Pool, reset between functions): Scopes are plain 80 B objects, a scope creator allocates its Vars from one jutil.Slab, the per-scope hash becomes map[uint32]int32 past 8 vars. Arena hooks left as no-ops.
mech_form: A faithful translation allocates Scope/Var as ordinary objects that die with the pass; nothing to do. The remaining idea (vars from a per-creator slab) is pass-specific.
notes: Reverts the scopeArena of Rounds 7-11 (9c895b43, 88070d50). Reason: arenas retained memory across passes; no number in this commit.

subject: perf(rhino,parsing): remove the JSDoc builder slabs
areas: rhino JSDocInfo, JSTypeExpression; parsing IRFactory, ParserRunner, JsDocInfoParser; jscomp prebuild_ast_parallel
what: Removes JSDocBuilderSlabs; JSDocInfo, JSTypeExpression, parameter maps and multi-value arrays are plain exact-size allocations.
measured_effect: typed-full peak heap: JSDoc parse-time objects other than type nodes 57.6 MB -> 6.2 MB (the any-slice slab alone held ~47 MB for ~1 MB of values)
mech_form: Plain allocation of JSDoc objects is what a mechanical translation produces.
notes: Reverts the JSDoc slabs of 9e0d389c (Round 2K). Reason: half-used chunks on the sequential path.

subject: jutil: fill Slab chunks to their size class
areas: jutil slab.go, collections.go
what: Slab chunks and presized LinkedHashMap slots are allocated with slices.Grow and use the whole size-class capacity, because pointerful arrays over 512 B carry an 8-byte malloc header that pushed power-of-two chunks into the next size class.
measured_effect: peak live at GOGC=10: bundle 344 -> 324 MB, checks-only 348 -> 325 MB, typed-app 121 -> 117 MB, typed-full unchanged
mech_form: Any chunked storage in the runtime (node store blocks, collection slot arrays) sizes its chunks to fill a Go size class (slices.Grow and use cap) instead of a power of two.

subject: perf(parser): SourcePosition and SourceRange as pointer-free values
areas: parser SourcePosition, SourceRange, tokens, trees (112 files), LineNumberScanner, ParseArena
what: SourcePosition becomes a 12-byte value {Offset, Line, Column int32} without *SourceFile and SourceRange holds two positions by value, stored inline in tokens/trees/comments; position slabs and the token-position cache are deleted; the source name comes from context.
measured_effect: retained parse tree typescript.js 241 -> 178 MB; bundle peak live (GOGC=10) 344 -> 285 MB; 1.9M positions and 2.2M ranges no longer allocated
mech_form: Uniform prep edit on the parser package: drop the SourceFile field from SourcePosition (pass the source via the reporter), narrow fields to int, mark SourcePosition/SourceRange as value classes; plus a TRANSLATOR rule that emits final immutable value classes as Go structs held by value.
notes: Changes behaviour of SourcePosition.toString (debug only), so the prep edit needs a check that nothing reads position.source.

subject: rhino: keep overflow lengths and NUMBER/TEMPLATELIT original names in the nodeExtBox
areas: rhino node.go nodeExtBox
what: Moves overflow lengths and NUMBER/TEMPLATELIT original names from global address-keyed shard maps (never cleared) into the node extension box.
notes: Fixes a leak and a stale-entry correctness bug of the global nodeExtraShards side tables from the 64 B Node work (2078675b, inferred). Lesson for a node store: side tables keyed by address must die with the node.

subject: perf(compiler,rhino,jutil): Round 2P — cut googleapis-bench heap allocs by 21.9% (41.00M -> 32.01M)
areas: rhino nodeExtBox pool in JSTypeRegistry; jutil Path, EnumSet/FeatureSet, BigInt cache; jscomp prebuildParallel (JsFileRegexParser reuse), MakeDeclaredNamesUnique, FunctionToBlockMutator, license tracker, UnionFind, UseSiteRenamer, CrossChunkCodeMotion, AnalyzePrototypeProperties, proto string append; default.pgo
what: Round 2P: nodeExtBox from registry slabs; jutil.Path as a zero-copy normalised string; per-worker regex parser and module loader reuse with an ASCII goog.provide/require fast path; noscan name byte slabs; DAG-memoised license tracking; O(1) UnionFind.NumSets; zero-alloc FeatureSet.Intersects; cached small BigInts; PGO refresh.
measured_effect: googleapis-bench heap allocs 41.00M -> 32.01M (-21.9%)
mech_form: algorithmic: mostly per-pass slabs, memoisation and reuse. allowed part: java.nio.Path as a normalised string with O(1) parent/prefix ops, EnumSet/FeatureSet set operations on bit words without allocation, small BigInteger cache, UTF-8 validity fast path in proto string append (all RUNTIME).

subject: jutil: index ObjectLinkedHashMap with the LinkedHashMap table
areas: jutil collections.go ObjectLinkedHashMap
what: ObjectLinkedHashMap (hashCode/equals keyed) drops its map[int32]int32 buckets and per-slot chains for the same open-addressing uint32 index as LinkedHashMap, probing by stored hash codes.
measured_effect: typed-full (GOGC=10) peak live 479 -> 473 MB, alloc 1.36 -> 1.34 GB
mech_form: Runtime hash map for keys with user hashCode/equals: slot slice with stored hash plus open-addressing uint32 index, no Go map and no chain links.

subject: perf(jscomp): drop the global CFG pools; reuse CFG storage per owner and release it with its scope
areas: jscomp ControlFlowAnalysis, LinkedDirectedGraph, CheckUnreachableCode, CheckMissingReturn, CoalesceVariableNames, DeadAssignmentsElimination, TypeInferencePass, FSIV
what: Deletes the global reusable-CFG caches and sync.Pools; a ReusableCfg is a plain value owned by its user and cleared on scope exit; graph nodes/edges come from a small per-graph slab that is rewound; astPosition is a Go map again.
measured_effect: typed-full peak at GOGC=10 540 -> 504 MB
mech_form: A faithful translation builds a fresh CFG per scope and drops it; the retained per-graph rewind slab is pass-specific.
notes: Reverts the CFG pools of Rounds 14/18 (6daef8ee, bf0be5bd) and the generation-stamped posTable of Round 20. Reason: the last TypeInference CFG pinned every TypedScope/TypedVar.

subject: refactor(jscomp): data flow analysis keeps its flow states in one slice
areas: jscomp DataFlowAnalysis, LiveVariablesAnalysis, MaybeReachingVariableUse, MustBeReachingVariableDef, TypeInference
what: DataFlowAnalysisBase replaces chunk lists, an inline buffer and separate reset/trim paths by one []LinearFlowState sized to the CFG and reused when large enough.
notes: Simplifies the flow-state chunking of a6603617. No number stated.

subject: jscomp: stop pinning whole source texts after use
areas: jscomp deps JsFileRegexParser, Compiler GenerateReport
what: Clones the provide/require names that were substrings of the file text (which pinned each whole file through DependencyInfo) and drops the source text cache once the warning report is printed.
measured_effect: typed-app 3.5 MB of source text; bundle 10 MB text + 3.7 MB line offsets; bundle-advanced-ts 16 MB (amounts no longer pinned)
mech_form: String helper semantics: runtime substring / regex-group helpers used for long-lived values must copy (Java substring copies), or a POSTFLIP rule inserts strings.Clone where a substring of file contents is stored in a field. The report cache drop is ALREADY-GENERAL if Java does it.
notes: Body says Java would have released the text, i.e. a Go substring-aliasing hazard any Go translation has.

subject: resources: read runtime_libs.typedast in place
areas: internal/resources resource_loader.go
what: Embeds runtime_libs.typedast as a string and hands out a read-only view instead of copying 3.5 MB onto the heap with fs.ReadFile.
measured_effect: 3.5 MB heap copy avoided per optimised build
mech_form: Resource loader in the runtime returns read-only views of go:embed data instead of heap copies.

subject: refactor(rhino): JSDocInfo.Property is one concrete struct
areas: rhino js_doc_info.go JSDocInfo.Property
what: Java Property<T> and its five subclasses (an 8-method Go interface plus five embedding structs and a parallel kind table) become one concrete struct with a kind field, removing dynamic dispatch on property access.
mech_form: Flatten a small private sealed subclass family into one final class with a kind enum and switch in the two overridden methods, before translation; or a TRANSLATOR rule that emits such hierarchies as a tagged struct.
notes: No number stated.

subject: parsing, rhino: allocate AST nodes one by one instead of from slabs
areas: parsing IRFactory, ParserRunner, JsDocInfoParser; rhino node.go cloneTree; jscomp ScriptNodeDeserializer, prebuild_ast_parallel
what: AST nodes (parsed, JSDoc type, deserialised, cloned) are allocated one by one instead of from chunked slabs; cloneTree is the Java recursion again.
measured_effect: peak live at GOGC=10: typed-full 516 -> ~450 MB, typed-app 131 -> 124, checks-only 348 -> ~325; typed-mega 999 -> 861 MB live, 1583 -> 1453 MB RSS; cost ~2.5M more heap objects on typed-full and ~5-10% more CPU (GC marking)
mech_form: Individual node allocation is the mechanical default. The lesson for a chunked node store: a chunk lives while any node in it does and pins everything dead neighbours reference, so chunked storage needs compaction or pointer-free nodes.
notes: Reverts node slabs of a6603617 and nodeCloneSlab of 80199f92. Superseded by f6aaec57 (chunks linked by 32-bit ids).

subject: jscomp, rhino: allocate qualified-name strings individually
areas: jscomp node_util.go; rhino node.go
what: Qualified-name strings are ordinary concatenations instead of being carved from global 32/64 KiB byte slabs that were never reset.
measured_effect: 25 MB of slabs live at typed-full optimisation peak for ~9 MB of reachable names
mech_form: Plain string concatenation is what the translator emits.
notes: Reverts the string byte slabs of earlier rounds.

subject: rhino: let the string pool's hash tables fill to 3/4
areas: rhino rhino_string_pool.go
what: String-pool open-addressed tables grow at 3/4 load instead of 1/2; pointer cell chunks sized to fill the 16 KiB size class.
measured_effect: string pool tables 8 -> ~5 MB on typed-full
mech_form: String pool hash table load factor 3/4 and size-class-exact chunks.

subject: perf(rhino): drop the JSTypeRegistry slabs; per-registry property symbols
areas: rhino JSTypeRegistry, ArrowType, FunctionType, NamedType, Property symbols
what: Drops the JSTypeRegistry slabs (types, properties, parameters, small slices are plain allocations) and moves the never-cleared package-level property-symbol list onto the registry so the type graph can be freed after conversion to colors.
measured_effect: typed-full (GOGC=10) peak live 505 -> 488 MB; checks-only 350 -> 337 MB
mech_form: Plain allocation of types is the mechanical default; a translated static list would live on the registry as in Java.
notes: Reverts registry slabs of 80199f92 / 520dcbc3 / e51f666b and fixes a leak through a package-level symbol list.

subject: refactor(jscomp): one reuseSlab for both linked graphs; coalesce reuses its interference graph via the graph API
areas: jscomp LinkedDirectedGraph, LinkedUndirectedGraph, CoalesceVariableNames, reuse_slab.go
what: One reuseSlab type backs both linked graphs; CoalesceVariableNames reuses its interference graph through the graph API; a reset slab keeps up to ~2,500 elements so mid-size functions stop reallocating.
mech_form: algorithmic: a rewindable slab inside graph objects that are reused across functions needs lifetime reasoning; could only be RUNTIME if the graph classes were moved into the runtime.
notes: No number stated.

subject: jscomp: plain allocation in ReferenceCollector
areas: jscomp ReferenceCollector (-991 lines), CrossChunkReferenceCollector, ReferenceCollection, InlineVariables
what: ReferenceCollector drops rcVarSlabs and pooled arenas: collections live in a map keyed by (scope root, name), references/blocks are plain objects, hoisted functions are a map, references carry their real scope as in Java; local reclamation kept.
mech_form: Java structure (map of collections, plain objects) is what a mechanical translation yields.
notes: Reverts ReferenceCollector arenas of Rounds 8-12 and 467bd3c0 / 9ffb31af. No number in this commit.

subject: jscomp: GlobalNamespace without arena pool; plain qualified-name strings
areas: jscomp GlobalNamespace (-491 lines), InlineAndCollapseProperties, node_util.go, TypeInference
what: Deletes the pooled globalNamespaceArena and shared name byte slabs; Names/Refs are plain allocations dropped with the pass, the concat cache lives only during traversal, a Name keeps one inline Ref and derives baseName (200 -> 160 B), name index presized from code statements only.
measured_effect: typed-full (GOGC=10) peak live 517 -> ~455 MB; Name 200 B -> 160 B
mech_form: Java drops the namespace when the pass ends; mechanical translation does the same. The inline single Ref is a pass-specific layout change.
notes: Reverts GlobalNamespace arena pooling of Round 14 (6daef8ee) and Round 16 cache growth.

subject: jscomp: RemoveUnusedCode state per run, no pooled arena or slabs
areas: jscomp RemoveUnusedCode
what: RemoveUnusedCode state is a plain per-run value instead of an arena cached in a package-level atomic and sync.Pool; VarInfos and Removables are individual allocations.
mech_form: Per-run pass state with plain objects is the mechanical default.
notes: Reverts RUC arena/slabs of Rounds 7-11 (88070d50). No number stated.

subject: jscomp: drop cross-run pools in InferConsts, inliners and Normalize
areas: jscomp InferConsts, InlineFunctions, InlineSimpleMethods, InlineVariables, Normalize
what: Drops cross-run sync.Pools and cached state in InferConsts, the inliners and Normalize; chunked BasicBlocks/FunctionStates/References and the unique-name string slab become plain allocations.
mech_form: Per-run state with plain allocation is the mechanical default.
notes: Reverts pools from Rounds 11, 13, 18, 21 and 2f2e42f1 / fd9525ce. No number stated (mentions 1.2 MB presized slices kept alive).

subject: jscomp: OptimizeCalls and property renaming without pools or slabs
areas: jscomp OptimizeCalls, AmbiguateProperties, RenameProperties, RenameVars, ColorGraphNodeFactory, ColorFindPropertyReferences, PhaseOptimizer
what: OptimizeCalls ReferenceMap and property-renaming lists are allocated per run with plain ArrayLists; hand-rolled slabs for assignments, properties, ColorGraphNodes, clusterings and union-find nodes are removed; adds listAddDoubling because append grows long lists by 1.25x.
mech_form: Per-run plain collections are the mechanical default. allowed part: runtime ArrayList grows by doubling (Go append 1.25x growth allocates ~5x a long list final size) (RUNTIME collections).
notes: Reverts pools/slabs of Rounds 11, 15, 17, 18. No number stated.

subject: jscomp: plain allocation for TypedScope and TypedVar; drop TypedScopeCreator pools
areas: jscomp TypedScope, TypedScopeCreator
what: TypedScopes and TypedVars are plain allocations instead of typedScopeArena chunks; the four sync.Pools of TypedScopeCreator (up to 512K-entry maps kept between compilations) are gone.
mech_form: Plain allocation of typed scopes is the mechanical default.
notes: Reverts typedScopeArena of Rounds 12/19. No number stated.

subject: jscomp: TypedVar keeps its name as a string instead of interning it
areas: jscomp AbstractVar, Var, TypedVar, SyntacticScopeCreator
what: TypedVar keeps its declared name as a string shared with the scope key instead of interning it into the string pool; Var keeps the id. TypedVar grows 56 -> 64 B, Var stays 40 B.
measured_effect: about 10 MB of string-pool spans and table on checks-only and typed-full no longer retained
mech_form: A translated TypedVar holds a string field. Lesson: interning rarely shared long qualified names costs more than it saves.
notes: Partially reverts c944567c (Var.nameID) for TypedVar.

subject: jutil: make Slab.New a plain new(T)
areas: jutil slab.go
what: Slab.New becomes plain new(T): no chunking, so one live element no longer keeps a whole chunk of dead neighbours.
measured_effect: peak live at GOGC=10: typed-full 473 -> 440 MB, typed-app 118 -> 107 MB, checks-only 327 -> 323 MB; typed-mega peak live 905 -> 832 MB, RSS 1290 -> 1224 MB; cost: typed-full 7.2M objects instead of 4.7M, user CPU +5-9%
mech_form: new(T) per object is the mechanical default.
notes: Reverts the generic jutil.Slab; partially restored for pass-lifetime objects in 09bb868a.

subject: sourcemap: keep the generator's mappings delta-encoded
areas: sourcemap SourceMapGeneratorV3
what: Mappings are stored as zigzag-varint deltas from the previous mapping (about 10 bytes) in 64 KB blocks and decoded in order during the output traversal, instead of 32-byte structs in pooled 16K-entry slabs.
measured_effect: output-phase live heap: typed-full 462 -> 426 MB, bundle-advanced-ts 251 -> 210 MB, bundle-mega 752 -> 670 MB; bundle-mega peak live (GOGC=10) 815 -> 711 MB
mech_form: algorithmic: changes the storage representation and traversal of the source-map generator by hand; would be RUNTIME only if the source-map generator were declared part of the runtime.

subject: jscomp: do not keep an input source map's text once it is parsed
areas: jscomp SourceMapInput
what: Drops the cached text of an input source map once it is parsed; it is re-read on demand.
measured_effect: bundle-mega: 20 MB of map texts no longer held through the output
mech_form: SourceFile content caching in the runtime I/O helper: do not memoise file text for one-shot readers (or expose clearCachedSource and have the translated SourceMapInput call it via a prep edit).
notes: Inferred: Java SourceFile caches the code too, so this may not be free in a faithful translation.

subject: refactor(jscomp): TypeInference's flow-scope arena and outcome slabs use reuseSlab
areas: jscomp LinkedFlowScope, TypeInference, reuse_slab.go
what: Five hand-rolled arenas (flow scopes, overlay scopes/slots, BooleanOutcomePairs, OptChainInfos) become reuseSlabs reset per CFG, keeping at most ~2,500 elements each.
mech_form: algorithmic: slab reuse of flow-scope objects per CFG requires knowing that none survive the function analysis.
notes: Simplification of the LinkedFlowScope arena from Round 14; no number.

subject: refactor(jscomp): live-variable, reaching-use and reaching-def lattices use reuseSlab
areas: jscomp LiveVariablesAnalysis, MaybeReachingVariableUse, MustBeReachingVariableDef, reuse_slab.go
what: Dataflow lattices move from append-only slabs with inline buffers and chunk lists to reuseSlab (zeroed or rewound on reset).
mech_form: algorithmic: per-analysis slab reuse needs lifetime reasoning about lattice objects.
notes: No number.

subject: perf(compiler,colors,rhino,args4j): eliminate 10M allocations and 509 MB optimization heap (Round 2Q)
areas: jscomp CommandLineRunner flags, ColorPool, JSDocSerializer, JSTypeReconserializer, DevirtualizeMethods, FunctionToBlockMutator, prebuild_dependency_info_parallel, ReferenceCollector, Scope; colors Color, ColorRegistry; args4j setters; jutil ObjectLinkedHashMap InitWithBuffer, Path, File, Slab; rhino node.go, InputId; default.pgo
what: Round 2Q: Colors and their sets slab-allocated with caller-provided slot buffers; args4j setters take strings without boxing; pooled string concatenation slabs in DevirtualizeMethods; pooled subclass-relation slabs in ColorRegistry; raw directory checks; assorted per-pass allocation cuts.
measured_effect: -10M allocations and -509 MB optimisation heap (subject)
mech_form: algorithmic: slabs with hand-reasoned lifetimes across colors and passes. allowed part: collections that can be initialised over a caller buffer / small inline storage (RUNTIME collections); typed setter fast path avoiding any-boxing of String option values (TRANSLATOR).
notes: No body; from subject and added functions (inferred:).

subject: jscomp: TypedScope keeps its vars in a slice with a pointer-free index
areas: jscomp TypedScope, TypeInference
what: TypedScope vars become a []*TypedVar in declaration order plus, past 8 vars, an open-addressed []uint32 index tagged with the name hash, replacing LinkedHashMap[string,*TypedVar] with its Go map index.
measured_effect: about 16 bytes per var instead of 50-70, no pointers in the index
mech_form: LinkedHashMap<String,V> in the runtime with a pointer-free uint32 open-addressing index and no index for small maps; when V carries its own key (getName) a keyless slot variant could be selected by a TRANSLATOR hint.
notes: Same idea as 5021f936 applied by hand to one class; in mech the runtime collection already gives most of it.

subject: jscomp: drop the scope-arena hooks from the passes; plain MemoizedScopeCreator
areas: jscomp 36 pass files, MemoizedScopeCreator
what: Deletes the now no-op scope-arena hooks (EnableArenaPool, EnableLocalScopeReclamation, ResetLocalArena, ReleaseArena) and their call sites; MemoizedScopeCreator is again a single map without the 8-entry array / last-hit cache.
notes: Cleanup after 7709f953 and 4571b1e5; no gain at stake.

subject: jscomp: RemoveUnusedCode looks up VarInfos in a map, as in Java
areas: jscomp RemoveUnusedCode
what: Replaces the hand-rolled var hash table, the Var.nameHash index, the 4096/2048-entry caches and the pinned property cache by the Java structure: a map keyed by (scope root, name) plus an ordered slice.
notes: Reverts RUC lookup machinery of Rounds 11/16. Measured as too allocation-heavy afterwards: 9c426561 reports the Go map allocated 61 MB vs 5 MB on bundle and went back to a chained table.

subject: jscomp: cut allocation churn of the per-run OptimizeCalls and GN maps
areas: jscomp OptimizeCalls, GlobalNamespace, RenameProperties
what: Presizes the per-run OptimizeCalls name/prop maps from the global var count, keeps the first 4 nodes of a reference list inline in its own allocation, presizes the GlobalNamespace index at 5 names per code statement.
mech_form: algorithmic: presizing heuristics and inline small lists tuned per pass. allowed part: ArrayList with small inline capacity (RUNTIME collections).
notes: Follow-up tuning after the pools were removed (1cbc096e, 49aa74b5). No number.

subject: perf(parser): delete the ParseArena; allocate tokens and trees normally
areas: parser parse_arena.go (deleted, -711 lines), Parser, Scanner, SourceFile; jscomp Compiler
what: Deletes the pooled ParseArena (~40 pointerful slabs and a reusable UTF-16 buffer); tokens and trees are plain allocations, list building uses three scratch stacks with exact-length copies.
measured_effect: retained parse tree typescript.js 178 -> 139 MB; bundle peak live (GOGC=10) 278 -> 243 MB; allocated objects up (bundle 1.6M -> 5.0M), bytes down, CPU unchanged
mech_form: Plain token/tree allocation is the mechanical default. allowed part: ImmutableList.Builder emitted as a scratch stack with an exact-length copy (TRANSLATOR/RUNTIME collections).
notes: Reverts the ParseArena of Rounds 9/10/16 (9c895b43, 080e9677).

subject: perf(parser): convert only the non-ASCII tail of the source to UTF-16
areas: parser SourceFile, Scanner, LineNumberScanner; parsing IRFactory
what: SourceFile no longer keeps the whole file as UTF-16 next to the UTF-8 text: the leading pure-ASCII part is read from the UTF-8 bytes (char index = byte index) and only the tail from the first non-ASCII byte is converted; Length/CharAt/Substring implement the Java String API.
measured_effect: -17 MB while typescript.js is parsed (all-ASCII file needs no UTF-16 copy)
mech_form: Java-String emulation in the runtime: a string type with charAt/length/substring over UTF-8 bytes with an ASCII-prefix fast path and lazy UTF-16 conversion of the non-ASCII tail, used by the translated scanner.

subject: perf(parser): drop the self back-pointer of parse trees and tokens
areas: parser ParseTree base, Token base, 92 tree files
what: Removes the 16-byte self interface back-pointer from parse-tree and token bases; the 85 asX() cast methods become Go type assertions at call sites; bool/enum fields move into base padding so several trees drop a size class.
measured_effect: retained parse tree typescript.js ~122 -> 90 MB; IdentifierToken 64 -> 48 B, ArgumentListTree 96 -> 80 B
mech_form: Do not emit a self interface field in base structs whose only use is downcasting helpers: translate asX() cast helper methods and (Bar) x casts to x.(*Bar) at the call site; order subclass bool/enum fields to fill base padding.
notes: Shows the cost of the embedding+self pattern: 16 B per object.

subject: perf(parsing): free each statement's parse tree once IRFactory has transformed it
areas: parsing IRFactory.ProcessBlock
what: Clears each statement slot of the parse tree once IRFactory has transformed it, so the parse tree of finished statements can be collected while the AST is built.
measured_effect: bundle WHITESPACE_ONLY peak live at GOGC=10 192 -> 136 MB
mech_form: Small targeted prep edit in IRFactory.processBlock (null the statement list entry after transforming it); not a uniform rule, so strictly a hand change to one method.
notes: Borderline: one-line pass-specific edit; classify NOT-ALLOWED if prep edits must be uniform.

subject: jscomp: RemoveUnusedCode var table as a chained hash; doubling growth
areas: jscomp RemoveUnusedCode, InferConsts, OptimizeCalls
what: Goes back from the Go map keyed by (scope root, name) to a plain chained hash table through RealVarInfo.hashNext, and grows the InferConsts var-state slices and RUC VarInfo list by doubling.
measured_effect: RUC var table allocation 61 MB (Go map) vs 5 MB (chained table) on bundle; append 1.25x growth allocates ~5x the final size
mech_form: Runtime HashMap for struct keys must not be a Go map with large composite keys: use a compact open-addressing/chained table with stored hashes; runtime ArrayList grows by doubling.
notes: Fixes the allocation regression introduced by 118dc6ee.

subject: perf(ast,jscomp,rhino,jutil): clamp slabs to <=32760B small spans, inline [3]JSType unions, and cut hot pass allocs
areas: jutil Slab; rhino JSTypeRegistry, UnionType (inline [3]JSType), RhinoStringPool; jscomp TypedScope, DefaultNameGenerator, ExtractPrototypeMemberDeclarations, PeepholeFoldConstants, PeepholeReplaceKnownMethods, NodeUtil, AbstractPeepholeOptimization, CrossChunkReferenceCollector; default.pgo
what: Clamps all slab/arena chunk sizes to <= 32,760 B so they stay in small spans, stores 2- and 3-member unions in an inline [3]JSType array, and cuts allocations in name generation, peephole folding and prototype member extraction.
measured_effect: ~500 MB of power-of-2 page rounding waste eliminated by the <=32,760 B clamp (Rounds 2A-2S summary)
mech_form: Chunked runtime storage (node blocks, collection slot chunks, string pool) capped at the Go small-object limit (32,760 B) and sized to a size class. allowed part also: small fixed-capacity inline storage for immutable short lists (TRANSLATOR hint). Per-pass allocation cuts are algorithmic.
notes: No body; from subject, file list and roadmap summary (inferred:).

subject: refactor(jscomp): plain allocation for the low-volume lattice objects
areas: jscomp MaybeReachingVariableUse, TypeInference
what: BooleanOutcomePairs, OptChainInfos and reaching-use lattices go back to ordinary allocation; measurement showed only CFG nodes/edges, live-variable lattices, flow scopes and interference edges (millions per compile) are worth a slab.
measured_effect: no measurable gain from slabs for the low-volume objects (thousands per compile)
notes: Reverts part of 4d810edc / 5bec97f9. Useful data point: slabs pay only for objects in the millions.

subject: perf(rhino): shrink the JSType structs (JSTypeBase 64 -> 32 bytes)
areas: rhino JSTypeBase and all JSType structs (30 files), PropertyMap, Property, FunctionType params
what: JSTypeBase 64 -> 32 B: the self interface becomes the itab word only (base is the first field), resolveResult is a *JSTypeBase, the registry is read through the TemplateTypeMap, serializer fields move out to a map; long-lived JSType fields hold *JSTypeBase (8 B instead of a 16 B interface); PropertyMap packs data pointer plus two 32-bit lengths.
measured_effect: peak live (GOGC=10): typed-full 505 -> 465 MB, typed-mega 831 -> 778 MB, shaka-blockly 235 -> 208 MB, typed-app 131 -> 125 MB, checks-only 350 -> ~335 MB; FunctionType 224 -> 160 B, PrototypeObjectType 144 -> 96 B, Property 40 -> 32 B
mech_form: Layout rules for class hierarchies: store references to an abstract class as a thin pointer to the base struct (8 B) and rebuild the interface from an itab word kept in the base; keep only the itab word for self; order and narrow fields; drop fields derivable from another field only where the Java source already does.
notes: Strong candidate: halves interface-reference cost across the type graph. Also relevant to CASTS.

subject: perf(rhino,jscomp): 128B UnionType, in-place AST mutation, conditional CloneTree, and refresh benchmarks (Round 2S)
areas: rhino UnionType, node.go in-place mutation helpers; jscomp DevirtualizeMethods, InlineAndCollapseProperties, InlineFunctions; docs, default.pgo
what: Round 2S: UnionType at 128 B with inline alternates; AST nodes mutated in place (GETPROP to NAME, THIS to NAME, statement to VAR) instead of creating replacements; CloneTree skipped for isolated statement-level functions being inlined; benchmark docs refreshed.
measured_effect: in-place mutation -150 MB NewNode live heap in OPTIMIZATIONS; googleapis-bench alloc_objects >130M -> 17.86M and 118.37 s -> 95.41 s, peak RSS 8,697 -> 6,084 MiB (cumulative for Rounds 2A-2S)
mech_form: algorithmic: in-place node mutation and conditional clone elision change pass logic and need proofs that the old node is dead. allowed part: Node.replaceWith(new node built from the old one) could be recognised by a POSTFLIP pattern only in trivial cases.
notes: Cumulative numbers are for the whole 2A-2S series, not this commit alone.

subject: jutil: restore the chunked Slab for objects that die together
areas: jutil slab.go
what: Restores the chunked Slab (chunks filled to their size class) for objects that die together with their pass (per-scope-creator Vars, union-find, use-site, deserializer slabs); documents that a slab must never hold long-lived objects with individual lifetimes.
mech_form: algorithmic: deciding which objects die together is per-pass lifetime reasoning.
notes: Partial re-introduction after e35a30e6. No number stated.

subject: perf(jscomp,rhino,jutil): Round 2T in-place AST mutations, ColorGraphNode inline slots, and module slabs
areas: jscomp FunctionArgumentInjector, InlineVariables, CollapseProperties, Normalize, PeepholeMinimizeConditions, DisambiguateProperties ColorGraphNode, PureFunctionIdentifier, OptimizeReturns, ClosureRewriteModule, TypedScopeCreator; default.pgo
what: Round 2T: leaf nodes overwritten from a clone and statements/expressions mutated in place; ColorGraphNode gets inline associated props with an 8-slot buffer; noscan byte-chunk key arena; closure-free post-order rewrite in OptimizeReturns; module descriptions slab-allocated.
measured_effect: googleapis-bench OPTIMIZATIONS alloc_objects 8.07M -> 6.07M (-24.8%); googleapis-bench 94.20 s compat / 93.06 s fast; bundle-mega peak RSS 1,614 -> 1,285 MiB
mech_form: algorithmic: in-place AST mutation and pass-private inline buffers/slabs. allowed part: closure-free emission of recursive post-order lambdas (TRANSLATOR).

subject: perf(jscomp,jutil,rhino): Round 2U SourceFile/CompilerInput/JSChunk slabs, 128-bit CoalesceVariableNames, and CHECKS/FINALIZATIONS alloc cuts
areas: jscomp SourceFile, CompilerInput, JSChunk, TypedAstDeserializer, ScriptNodeDeserializer, CoalesceVariableNames (128-bit), SemanticReverseAbstractInterpreter, SortedDependencies; jutil BitSet, Path, files_read, LinkedHashMap; default.pgo
what: Round 2U: SourceFile / CompilerInput / JSChunk / deserializer objects from slabs; CoalesceVariableNames uses two-word (128-bit) liveness sets for small functions; SemanticReverseAbstractInterpreter tracks refinements without allocating scopes; raw file reads and path parsing shortcuts.
mech_form: algorithmic: slabs for long-lived inputs and a specialised 128-bit dataflow path. allowed part: BitSet with inline words for <= 128 bits (RUNTIME collections).
notes: No body; from subject and added functions (inferred:).

subject: perf(jscomp,rhino): Round 2V specialized NodeTraversal fast modes, zero-alloc qname checks, and CLI-gated GC eviction
areas: jscomp NodeTraversal (traverseBranchPostOrder / traverseBranchFull), TypedScopeCreator, TypeCheck, ProcessClosurePrimitives, ExpressionDecomposer, NodeUtil, default_pass_config; cmd/jsgo main.go; default.pgo
what: Round 2V: specialised NodeTraversal loops chosen by callback capabilities, qualified-name checks that return the name string without allocation, and a single-process CLI flag that gates pool/cache eviction (pools are only kept when the process compiles once).
mech_form: algorithmic: specialised traversal modes selected per callback and CLI-gated pooling. allowed part: none beyond what the runtime node helpers already give.
notes: No body; from subject and added functions (inferred:).

subject: jscomp: convert types on detached nodes at typesToColors so the JSType graph is released
areas: jscomp ConvertTypesToColors, Compiler, Timeline; cmd/jsgo (heap profile hook)
what: ConvertTypesToColors also converts detached nodes that stay reachable (change timeline, module metadata, diagnostics) and drops the cached AstAnalyzer, so no JSType and thus not the registry survives into the optimisations.
measured_effect: live heap after typesToColors: typed-app 71 -> 52 MB, typed-full 210 -> 151 MB
mech_form: algorithmic: hand-written extra conversion of detached nodes in one pass. In Java the same nodes also keep their JSTypes, so a faithful translation inherits the retention; a RUNTIME alternative is a node store where the type slot of every node is cleared wholesale at the typesToColors boundary.
notes: High value for MEMORY: 28% of live heap after checks. The node-store-wide slot clear is an inferred alternative, not what the commit does.

subject: jscomp: keep TypedScope's module and reserved names in a build-time side struct
areas: jscomp TypedScope
what: Module and reserved-name fields used only while TypedScopeCreator builds the scope move to a side struct dropped by ValidateCompletelyBuilt.
measured_effect: built TypedScope 128 -> 96 B
mech_form: algorithmic: requires knowing which fields are build-time only for this class.

subject: jscomp: build only define and global-constant names in ProcessDefines' GlobalNamespace
areas: jscomp GlobalNamespace, ProcessDefines
what: A cheap pre-pass collects @define and global-constant qualified names and the GlobalNamespace built for ProcessDefines skips every other name.
measured_effect: 141k names -> 10k on checks-only; namespace 43 MB -> 8 MB on typed-full
mech_form: algorithmic: pass-level pre-filter of which names enter the namespace.

subject: perf(jscomp,parser,jutil): per-pass slabs for scopes, references, tokens and parse trees
areas: jscomp ReferenceCollector, InferConsts, CrossChunkReferenceCollector, SyntacticScopeCreator/Scope, RemoveUnusedCode, GlobalNamespace, OptimizeCalls, InlineFunctions; parser Scanner, Parser; jutil Slab
what: Re-introduces slabs, this time owned by one pass run: references/collections/basic blocks (split global vs local), scopes next to vars, RUC removables and var infos, GN Names/Refs, tokens (with a separate slab for tokens trees never keep) and common parse trees; Scope.varIndex is an open-addressing []int32; Slab ramps from 4 elements.
measured_effect: objects allocated per compilation: typed-full 30.2M -> 10.6M, bundle-mega 68.8M -> 17.6M, bundle 15.1M -> 4.0M; peak live unchanged (typed-full 271 -> 276 MB, bundle-mega 438 -> 439 MB, checks-only 189 -> 186 MB)
mech_form: algorithmic: per-pass slabs whose safety rests on hand-reasoned lifetimes (objects die with the pass, tokens not kept by trees). allowed part: none general; a translator could only do this with an escape/lifetime analysis per pass.
notes: Shows the balanced end state: pass-lifetime slabs cut object count by two thirds at no heap cost.

subject: perf(jscomp): grow reference lists from the collector's pointer chunks
areas: jscomp ReferenceCollector; jutil slab.go
what: A full reference list of up to 64 slots grows into a twice-as-long slice carved from the collector shared pointer chunk instead of a fresh array.
measured_effect: bundle-mega allocated 0.9M such arrays before
mech_form: algorithmic: list growth out of a pass-owned chunk.
notes: Follow-up to 8031b62e.

subject: perf(rhino): store nodes in chunks linked by 32-bit ids
areas: rhino node.go (chunk table, generations); parsing IRFactory, JsDocInfoParser; jscomp ScriptNodeDeserializer, FunctionToBlockMutator
what: Node.next/first/parent/previous become uint32 ids into a process-wide table of 4096-node chunks (id = chunk<<12 | slot, 0 = nil); Node shrinks 64 -> 56 B; *Node stays the handle and accessors translate ids; chunks belong to generations so any held *Node keeps reachable chunks alive; allocation is a lock-free bump.
measured_effect: Node 64 B -> 56 B
mech_form: Node store in the runtime: nodes in fixed-size chunks linked by 32-bit ids with accessor methods translating ids, generation-owned chunk table, lock-free bump allocation; the translated passes keep using *Node unchanged.
notes: Directly applicable to the mech node store (108 B per node with pointers). Body states sizes only, no heap numbers; see docs/memory-research/round2-ast-links.md (not opened).

subject: perf(jscomp,rhino): copying AST compaction after typesToColors and in the optimization loop
areas: internal/rhino node_compact.go; jscomp compiler_compact.go, phase_optimizer.go
what: Adds rhino.Compactor: copies the live AST in pre-order into a fresh node generation, forwards every holder through an explicit registry (roots, change timeline, module metadata, JSErrors, runtime-lib node, CCA arena cache...) and releases old generations. Runs after typesToColors and in the optimization loop when nodes allocated since last compaction exceed half of live nodes; fast mode only at this commit; poison mode for unforwarded holders.
measured_effect: memory round 2 step table, ids-without-compaction vs compaction on: typed-full RSS 583 -> 475 MB, live 255 -> 230 MB; typed-mega RSS 944 -> 787 MB; bundle RSS 310 -> 280 MB (noisy host, wall +-10%)
mech_form: Handwritten node-store runtime: a compactor that copies/slides live records and remaps ids. The holder forwarding registry is the hard part: mech would need the translator to emit a generated "forward node ids" method for every type holding Node fields, rather than a hand census.
notes: Copying design replaced by in-place compaction in 583f730a. Fixed by 1f781975 and abd02bcf. inferred: the docs table measures the merged round-2 tree, not this commit alone.

subject: sourcemap: store input source map entries as per-line delta varints
areas: internal/sourcemap source_map_consumer_v3.go; jscomp compiler.go
what: Input source map entries stored as per-line zigzag delta varint byte stream with a one-line decode cache instead of 4-5 int32 per entry; sourcesContent dropped once the output map is known not to include it.
measured_effect: before: 1.4M entries, 49 MB kept through output on bundle-mega (saving not quantified)
mech_form: algorithmic: hand redesign of SourceMapConsumerV3 internal storage (a translated class), plus lifetime reasoning for dropping sourcesContent.

subject: fix(jscomp,rhino): a node generation per Compiler, immortal sentinels left in place by compaction
areas: internal/rhino node_compact.go, node_store.go; jscomp compiler.go
what: NewCompiler starts its own node generation (the initial one was never released); Forward leaves initial-generation immortal sentinel nodes in place; adds NodeChunksLive and a release test.
notes: Fixes 1762af68 (compaction): generations not released, shared JSDoc placeholder sentinel.

subject: fix(jscomp): no AST compaction in a NestedCompilerRunner's shadow compiler
areas: internal/jscomp compiler_compact.go, nested_compiler_runner.go
what: Disables AST compaction in a NestedCompilerRunner shadow compiler (its tree is held by the outer compilation); lowers the compaction threshold from half to a quarter of live nodes (half never triggered on benchmark tasks).
notes: Fixes/tunes 1762af68.

subject: perf(rhino,jscomp): Node refers to its JSType/Color and cold data through 32-bit handles
areas: internal/rhino node.go, node_tables.go, jstype_js_type.go; jscomp compiler lifetime
what: Node.typeOrColor (unsafe.Pointer to JSType/Color/JSDocInfo/ext box) becomes two uint32 handles (tc, aux) into process-wide block tables; the 64-byte node keeps only its four tree links as pointers (PtrBytes 40 -> 32), ext box 48 -> 32 B. JSType handles are allocated lazily by the registry and released wholesale by ClearJSTypeRegistry; lock-free readers, mutex on allocation.
measured_effect: scannable heap at the peak (GOGC=10): typed-app 48 -> 45 MB, checks-only 127 -> 116, typed-full 183 -> 164, typed-mega 291 -> 270
mech_form: Handwritten node-store runtime: node record refers to its JSType/Color and cold data (JSDoc, rare props) through 32-bit handles into typed side tables owned by the store, so node blocks hold fewer/no GC pointers and the type registry can be dropped without nodes pinning it.
notes: Lifetime bug fixed by 9aa6cb75. Process-wide tables replaced by per-store tables in 9d6b8981.

subject: perf(jutil): slab chunks are one-page size classes (256 B to 8 KB)
areas: internal/jutil slab.go; cmd/jsgo memstats.go
what: Slab chunk sizes now double from 256 B to 8 KB (size classes whose spans are one page) instead of ramping by element count into 9.5-21 KB chunks that need multi-page spans; JSGO_MEMSTATS records the /memory/classes breakdown.
measured_effect: googleapis OPTIMIZATIONS peak RSS 5.62 -> 4.96 GB (the multi-page chunks had raised it 14% from 4.94), object count still 52 M (was 149 M); benchmarks unchanged
mech_form: If the runtime has any slab/chunked allocator (node blocks, collection chunks), size chunks to Go size classes whose spans are a single 8 KB page so freed pages are reusable; a pure runtime constant choice.
notes: Fixes an RSS regression of the earlier slab introduction; most pass-level slabs were removed later (fd4f9d84, a8e95c2d, dc2873d7).

subject: perf(jscomp): parallelize script-local check and optimization passes (Round 3A)
areas: internal/jscomp StrictModeCheck, CheckRegExp, CheckSideEffects, CheckSuper, ClosureCheckModule, CombinedCompilerPass, RemoveCastNodes, PeepholeOptimizationsPass, InlineFunctions; jutil collections.go; rhino JSTypeRegistry
what: Round 3A: runs script-independent check passes and peephole/InlineFunctions phases on --num_parallel_threads workers with deterministic script-order replay of diagnostics, change notifications and deleted functions; SetParallelReadOnly on JSTypeRegistry, atomic lazy-index publication in jutil.LinkedHashMap/Set; refreshes default.pgo.
mech_form: parallelism: upstream Java runs these passes serially. Also pgo/gc (profile refresh). allowed part: race-free read-only lookups in the runtime LinkedHashMap (atomic publication of the lazy index).
notes: docs/benchmarks.md:2622 measures this commit against Java only, no before/after delta.

subject: perf(rhino): make nodeAt inlinable
areas: internal/rhino node_store.go (nodeAt)
what: nodeAt cost 100 against the Go inline budget of 80, so every GetNext/GetFirstChild/GetParent was a call; an inline panic instead of the staleNodeID call and a direct atomic load bring it to 34.
measured_effect: typed-full 27.11 -> 25.26 s (-6.8%), bundle 11.40 -> 10.70 s (-6.1%), medians of 5 interleaved runs
mech_form: Handwritten node-store runtime: keep the id-to-record lookup under the Go inlining budget (no out-of-line slow-path call in the accessor, inline panic) so every translated node accessor inlines.
notes: Prerequisite for an id-based node store not costing speed.

subject: WIP(rhino): node handles into per-compilation NodeStores (16-byte handle)

what: Round 98: SIMPLE-mode polyfill-free parallel local units and an O(1) AST-unchanged skip in RemoveUnusedCode; InlineFunctions shards large scripts, top-level IIFEs and statement blocks across workers with a 4096-bit identifier Bloom prefilter; ConvertTypesToColors, part of Normalize and FirstOrderFunctionAnalyzer run in parallel; TypeInferencePass walks scopes in a fast pre-order and reuses maps across ControlFlowAnalysis/TypeInference.
measured_effect: rounds 97-98 together: checks-only 1.16x, bundle 1.15x (5.28 s vs 6.06 s), typed-full 1.12x, googleapis 1.09x (164.7 s vs 180.3 s); post-flip ladder: InlineFunctions sharding -0.9% googleapis / -2.2% 9-task (inlineFunctions -26.5%), Stage-1 check/color parallelism group -7.1% googleapis
mech_form: parallelism: sharding of InlineFunctions, ConvertTypesToColors, Normalize and scope building, all serial upstream. allowed part: reusing scratch maps across ControlFlowAnalysis/TypeInference runs only if expressible as a non-escaping-allocation hoist (POSTFLIP-TOOL).
notes: #13 InlineFunctions dependency sharding (Tier 3: 3 race/ordering bug commits for <1%), #9 (Colors/Stage 1), #4 (Normalize), #12 (RUC skip). Fixed by 645ecb68.

subject: fix,perf(jscomp,sourcemap): fix StripCode OPTCHAIN_CALL panic and bound parallel chunk/sourcemap memory
areas: jscomp compiler_chunk_output.go, source_map.go, strip_code.go; sourcemap mapping_store.go, source_map_generator_v3.go

notes: Fixes unbounded transient memory of the parallel chunk/source-map output added in 084e8292 (#19, whose post_flip entry lists OOM bugs). Commit has no body; description from docs/benchmarks.md:402. The StripCode fix is unrelated to performance.

subject: perf,bench(jscomp,parser): Stage-1 benchmarks and CheckConformance, GENERATE_IJS, and UTF-8 scanner optimizations
areas: parser source_file.go, scanner.go, scanner_literals_and_ident.go; jscomp check_conformance.go, conformance_rules.go, ijs_convert_to_typed_interface.go; tools/bench new Stage-1 tasks
what: Adds Stage-1 benchmark tasks (conformance-checks, generate-ijs, incremental-ijs-check) and optimizes them: SourceFile maps UTF-16 offsets to UTF-8 byte offsets in O(1) (ASCII prefix/suffix plus a checkpoint every 32 code units) with zero-copy ASCII slices, the scanner works on UTF-8 bytes, and CheckConformance filters rules by a static token set.
measured_effect: post-flip ladder: CheckConformance static token bitmask 0.0% googleapis / -1.0% 9-task (-8.6% on conformance-checks alone); UTF-8 Scanner + WTF-8 checkpoints + parser slabs as a whole -1.3% googleapis / -1.9% 9-task (parseInputs -29.1%)
mech_form: String runtime: keep source text as UTF-8 with an O(1) UTF-16-offset-to-byte-offset table (checkpoints) so charAt/substring on source files do not need a UTF-16 copy. The byte-level scanner itself is a hand rewrite of the parser front end (not allowed as such); the conformance token filter is pass-specific (NOT-ALLOWED: algorithmic, or the token-mask POSTFLIP-TOOL if derivable from the rule's switch).
notes: #17 CheckConformance static token bitmask and part of #14 (UTF-8 Scanner / WTF-8 checkpoints). Commit has no body; classified from subject, file stat and added comments. No A/B of this commit against its predecessor in the docs (docs/benchmarks.md:398 is 131eca4b vs the next commit). inferred: how much of #14 landed here versus earlier.

subject: perf(stage1): parallelize front-end check/module passes and streamline AST/scope/type inference
areas: rhino NodeStore (blockAllocMu), NodeAllocator; parsing IRFactory pool; jscomp TypedScopeCreator, TypeInferencePass, CheckConformance, ConvertToTypedInterface, ConstCheck, GatherModuleMetadata, ScopedAliases, Es6RewriteModules, InferJSDocInfo, VarCheck, ProcessClosurePrimitives, ClosureRewriteModule, ProcessDefines, GlobalNamespace
what: Parallelizes about 17 front-end check/module passes across scripts with deterministic replay; unlocks block allocation in the NodeStore and adds cached-template NodeAllocator constructors and a pooled IRFactory; adds zero-traversal fast paths in TypedScopeCreator/TypeInferencePass for empty blocks, simple functions and bodyless functions, per-script caches and token-filtered scope-builder traversals; restricts ProcessDefines/GlobalNamespace work.
measured_effect: against 131eca4b: conformance-checks 1.22x (1.72 s vs 2.09 s), generate-ijs 1.13x (0.35 s vs 0.39 s), checks-only 1.12x (1.11 s vs 1.24 s), googleapis CHECKS 1.11x (39.56 s vs 44.01 s), googleapis total 1.06x (80.05 s vs 84.90 s), typed-full 1.04x; post-flip ladder for Stage-1 check/color parallelism: -7.1% googleapis / -8.9% 9-task
mech_form: parallelism: per-script workers for front-end passes that upstream runs serially. allowed part: RUNTIME node store with finer-grained block allocation locking and per-worker allocators for the parallel parse that upstream already has; RUNTIME cached-template node construction. The TypedScopeCreator/TypeInferencePass fast paths are hand algorithmic changes.
notes: #9 Stage-1 check/color parallelism + RecordingCompiler (largest single wall-time drop in the ladder); TypedScope fast paths relate to #15. The typed-scope and inference fast paths address the CHECKS gap but are not expressible mechanically.

subject: fix(jscomp,parsing,rhino,strpool): upstream parity fixes and persistent-worker hardening
areas: jscomp InlineObjectLiterals (iolVarFilter), compiler_state_binary.go, RunFinalizationsBatch, PhaseOptimizer, parallelFastGzipWriter, compiler_compact.go, PeepholeOptimizationsPass parallel waves, CollapseProperties, JSTypeRegistry/FunctionTypeBase; strpool and rhino static baseline; plus StripCode, CodeGenerator, Es6NormalizeClasses, CommonJS parity fixes
what: Bug-fix bundle: InlineObjectLiterals Bloom saturation letting escaped non-candidates bypass validation; binary save-state format bump, uvarint fields and bounded section reads; worker-goroutine panic recovery; compaction clears the property index and resets Var.nameHash; parallel peephole waves iterate bottom-up to match sequential folding; lazy call/bind/apply property accesses recorded safely in parallel read-only mode; several upstream parity fixes.
notes: Fixes bugs in earlier optimisations: #10 InlineObjectLiterals Bloom (a6c7ea5d), #23 binary save-state (10df6e7e), #22 compaction vs #16 property index (f67a53c7/6e08e8e3), #7 parallel Peephole wave order (3ac34a0e), #3 parallel TypeCheck type-layer writes (de2d9cae/de846a4e). The remaining items are correctness fixes unrelated to performance.
